old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with green fireworks, their sparks radiating outward. As the scene progresses, the display shifts to bursts of red and orange fireworks, creating a dynamic contrast. Smoke fills the sky, obscuring parts of the display and adding to the visual texture.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with a burst of red fireworks, their sparks radiating outward in a dazzling array of light. As the camera pans upward, the scene transitions to a burst of green fireworks, creating a mesmerizing contrast with the red. The camera then shifts focus to a cluster of white fireworks, which explode into a dense cloud of light, momentarily obscuring the view. Following this, a burst of pink fireworks illuminates the sky, adding another layer of color to the spectacle. The final frames show a burst of orange fireworks, their bright hues standing out vividly against the night backdrop. Throughout the video, the camera remains steady, capturing the dynamic and colorful explosions from a fixed position, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the beauty and intensity of the fireworks.
caption: The video captures a fireworks display unfolding against a night sky filled with drifting smoke. A thick green-tinted haze fills the upper and central frame, scattered with green, blue, white and orange sparks and faint wire-like lines at the left, then gradually dims into gray smoke. As the haze clears, a small orange starburst at the lower right expands into a wide multi-point shell with bright green cores, joined by additional gold-and-green bursts blooming across the top and right. A deep red glow swells from the bottom center while several white-headed red ascenders rise, dragging curving spark trails upward through the frame. A tall vertical column of gold fountain sparks builds on the right and keeps lengthening. Sparse individual sparks and short falling trails drift downward throughout the display. Near the close, a utility pole and wire are visible at the lower left.
